capabilities: Open or create the note for a period from a template
Turn on next, previous, and open commands per period
Insert links to period notes with @ phrases while writing
Rename existing notes to a new name format
Compute season, solar term, and zodiac year start dates astronomically
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.1 or later. Deeper documentation on periods, name formats, templates, and renaming lives on separate linked pages; the README covers setup, usage, and date accuracy.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Daily notes covers only single days, with no built-in way to open notes for weeks, quarters, seasons, fiscal years, or other recurring periods.

relations.evidence: With Natural Language Dates on, @ stays with it

summary: Periodic notes plugin that opens or creates notes for weeks, months, seasons, fiscal years, and many cultural periods, from templates.
